title: Why Fear Is Contagious: The Science of Emotional Contagion
hook: Your mood is not entirely your own, it is a shared experience.

narration.text: Your mood is not entirely your own, it is a shared experience.
This phenomenon is called emotional contagion, and it explains why feelings spread so easily.
We often unconsciously mimic the facial expressions and body language of others around us.
This mimicry can then trigger the same emotional states within ourselves.
It is a fundamental part of human empathy and social bonding.
Next time you feel a shift in your mood, consider who is nearby.
Have you noticed yourself catching someone else's mood before?

description: Ever wondered why you suddenly feel happy or stressed just by being around others? This is emotional contagion, a powerful process where feelings spread from person to person. Understanding it helps us recognise the subtle ways we influence each other's emotional states.
topic: Why you often adopt the mood of people around you, explaining emotional contagion.
